skills.label: Core Passive: Accelerant (Core Skill level 7)
skills.gameText:
Lighter automatically gains Morale over time, at a rate of 2.9 points per second. For each point of Energy consumed by any squad member, Lighter recovers an additional 0.26 Morale, up to a maximum of 100. When Morale reaches 80, the next time Lighter switches into battle he immediately launches a Quick Assist. Once Morale is 80 or higher, executing the 5th hit of his Basic Attack puts Lighter in the Morale Burst state, enhancing the power of the startup light punch, jab combo, and the Finishing Move of the 5th hit of his Basic Attack. When a skill hits an enemy with its power increased, it will continuously consume Morale. With every 10 points of Morale consumed, Lighter's Impact increases by 2%, up to a maximum increase of 20%, and lasting 6s.
In the Morale Burst state, Lighter will no longer automatically gain Morale over time. If his Morale is exhausted during a startup light punch or jab combo, he will automatically follow up with a more powerful Finishing Move.
In the Morale Burst state, when startup light punches or jab combos hit enemies, the target's Ice RES and Fire RES are reduced by 15%, lasting 30s.
In the Morale Burst state, when the Finishing Move hits an enemy, it applies the Collapse effect on the target, extending its Stunned duration by 3s. The Collapse effect can trigger only once on the same target before they recover from Stun.
When the Finishing Move of the 5th hit of his Basic Attack hits an enemy, when he switches off field, or when his Morale runs out, Lighter will leave the Morale Burst state, keeping any unspent Morale.

skills.label: Additional Ability: Fighting Spirit
skills.gameText:
When another character in your squad is an Attack character or shares the same Faction:
While under the Morale Burst state, when the 5th hit of Lighter's Basic Attack hits an enemy, all squad members gain a stack of Elation, stacking up to 20 times and lasting 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. For each stack of Elation, an Agent's Ice DMG and Fire DMG increase by 1.25%.
When obtaining Elation, if Lighter's Impact exceeds 170, every additional 10 points of Impact will increase the buff effect provided by each stack of Elation by an extra 0.25%. When any squad member launches a Chain Attack, it will refresh the duration of all squad members' Elation. Elation can increase the Ice DMG and Fire DMG of Agents by a maximum of 75%.

The more powerful Finishing Move that follows when Lighter's Morale is completely exhausted during a startup light punch or jab combo deals 30% increased DMG.

skills.label: Core Passive: Terminating Verdict (Core Skill level 7)
skills.gameText:

When the Finishing Move of EX Special Attack: Soul Hunter - Punishment or Ultimate: Blaspheme hits an enemy while they are Stunned, it triggers the Totalize effect, increasing the DMG Multiplier of the skill's Finishing Move by 1,000%. Additionally, the Totalize effect further increases the skill's DMG multiplier based on the remaining Stun time of the enemy when triggered: for each remaining second of Stun time from the portion that is less than or equal to 5s, the skill's DMG multiplier increases by 280%; for each remaining second of Stun time from the portion between 5 and 15s, the skill's DMG multiplier increases by 100%. The total increase can raise the skill's DMG multiplier by a maximum of 3,400%.
After Hugo triggers the Totalize effect, the enemy's Stunned state will immediately end. Based on the remaining Stun time at the moment Totalize is triggered, a certain amount of Daze will be accumulated. For every second of Stun time remaining, 5% Daze is accumulated, up to a maximum Daze equivalent to 25% of the enemy's maximum Daze.
When EX Special Attack: Soul Hunter - Punishment hits an enemy, if the enemy is not Stunned, the Daze accumulated by the skill increases by 20%.

skills.gameText:
When Zhao has maximum Frostbite Points, and is in combat, press [Switch button] to activate:
Launches consecutive attacks forward, followed by a slash, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Upon activating this skill, all Frostbite Points are consumed to activate Ether Veil: Wellspring.
Upon activating this skill, a Quick Assist is triggered. If a squadmate is then switched in via Quick Assist, Zhao automatically follows up with Basic Attack: Final Verdict and begins charging.
Activating this skill is considered as activating a Quick Assist.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Quick Assist: Patch the Gaps
skills.gameText:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch button] to activate:
Launches a falling slash in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Defensive Assist: Frostveil Suppression
skills.gameText:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch button] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Assist Follow-Up: Frostlight Reflection
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Launch multiple slashes in front, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Upon activating this skill, if Frostbite Points are maxed out, all Frostbite Points are consumed to activate Ether Veil: Wellspring.
Upon activating this skill while in any Ether Veil, a Quick Assist is triggered. If a squadmate is then switched in via Quick Assist, Zhao automatically follows up with Basic Attack: Final Verdict and begins charging.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Core Passive: Ideal Colleague (Core Skill level 7)
skills.gameText:
Zhao gains bonus CRIT Rate based on her initial Max HP, gaining 1.4% CRIT Rate for every 1,000 initial Max HP.
Upon entering the battlefield, Zhao gains 100 Frostbite Points. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode. The maximum amount of Frostbite Points is 100.
When the currently active character's attacks hit an enemy, Zhao gains 6 Frostbite Points. This can be triggered once every 3s.
When Frostbite Points are maxed out, switching Zhao to the field while in combat will activate her Entry Skill.
When Zhao activates her Entry Skill, all Frostbite Points are consumed to activate Ether Veil: Wellspring.
While Ether Veil: Wellspring is active, all squad members gain 5% Max HP for 40s. Re-activating Ether Veil: Wellspring ends the existing instance before applying a new Ether Veil: Wellspring.
When Zhao activates Ether Veil: Wellspring, all squad members' ATK increase by 1,000 for 50s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

skills.label: Additional Ability: Crystallization
skills.gameText:
When another character in your squad is an Attack, Anomaly, or Support character:
When Zhao is within any Ether Veil, the whole squad's DMG increases by 10%. If Zhao's initial Max HP exceeds 15,000, every additional 400 initial Max HP increases this DMG bonus by an additional 1%, up to a total maximum increase of 40%. This bonus reaches its maximum when Zhao's initial Max HP reaches 27,000.

skills.label: Mindscape 1: Righteous Verdict
skills.gameText: When Zhao switches out of being the active character, all squad members' DMG ignores 15% of the target's All-Attribute RES for 50s.

skills.label: Mindscape 2: Krampus Senior
skills.gameText: When Zhao recovers HP, her ATK increases by 20%, and other squad members' ATK increases by 15% for 50s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

skills.label: Mindscape 3: Frostveil Edge
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 4: Featherlight Footsteps
skills.gameText: When Zhao activates an Ether Veil, she gains 250 Decibels. The CRIT DMG of her Ultimate, Chain Attack, and Basic Attack: Final Verdict increase by 40%.

skills.label: Mindscape 5: Fuzzy Listener
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 6: No Value Has Its Own Value
skills.gameText: The CRIT Rate buff from Core Passive: Ideal Colleague increases to 125% of the original value. The extra DMG gained from charging during Basic Attack: Final Verdict increases to 140% of the original value, and accumulated charge time is no longer consumed when attacking.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Unyielding Strikes
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Launches up to four consecutive melee attacks, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.label: Dodge: Light as a Swallow
skills.gameText:
Press [Dodge button] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Dash Attack: Sizzling Oil Supreme
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a dodge to activate:
Perform a quick forward melee attack, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.label: Dodge Counter: Moving Mountains and Seas
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Perform a melee attack on enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Special Attack: Sonic Pressure-Point Strike
skills.gameText:
Press [Special Attack button] to activate:
Delivers a forward melee technique while tossing firecrackers, dealing Physical DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.label: Special Attack: Touch of Death
skills.gameText:
With Break Force, press [Special Attack button]to activate:
Special Attack: Touch of Death attacks centered on the enemy, dealing Physical DMG.
The skill can be chained up to three times. Each use of Special Attack: Touch of Death consumes 1 point of Break Force.
When Pan Yinhu is the active character, DMG received during the skill is reduced by 40% and Anti-Interrupt Level is increased. If he isn't the active character, he becomes Invulnerable.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Mountainous Pulse Strike
skills.gameText:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack button] to activate:
EX Special Attack: Mountainous Pulse Strike unleashes a powerful strike forward, dealing Physical DMG.
Gain 3 points of Break Force on activation. Upon hitting an enemy, it triggers the Quick Assist of the previous character in the squad.
Agents who enter the field via this Quick Assist will gain the Sheer Force bonus from the Core Passive. After switching out, Pan Yinhu will stay on the field and automatically launch Special Attack: Touch of Death until his Break Force runs out, where he then leaves the field.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Chain Attack: Anointed with Wok Steam
skills.gameText:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Hop onto the Iron Wok and spin rapidly to ram into enemies, dealing massive Physical DMG to all enemies on the way.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor!
skills.gameText:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate button] to activate:
Perform a technique that compresses qi into fried rice and catapults it at foes, dealing massive Physical DMG and healing all squad members for (100 + 60 × Chain Attack level) HP, while also applying a 8s heal over time on all squad members, recovering (0.8 + 0.05 × Chain Attack level)% HP/s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Quick Assist: Lift Your Gaze to Good Fortune
skills.gameText:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch button] to activate:
Perform a melee attack on enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Defensive Assist: Intimidating Presence
skills.gameText:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch button] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Assist Follow-Up: Ride the Momentum
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Perform a melee attack on enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Core Passive: Meridian Enlightenment (Core Skill level 7)
skills.gameText: For a brief period when Pan Yinhu's EX Special Attack: Mountainous Pulse Strike hits an enemy and triggers Quick Assist, the next Agent entering through a Quick Assist or Chain Attack will gain the Meridian Flow effect. This effect provides a Sheer Force boost equal to 18% of Pan Yinhu's initial ATK and lasts for 25s. The Sheer Force provided by this effect cannot exceed 540 points.

skills.label: Additional Ability: Iron Stomach
skills.gameText:
When another character in your squad is a Rupture character or shares the same Faction:
When Pan Yinhu hits an enemy with Special Attack: Touch of Death, the enemy suffers the Depleted Qi effect, increasing DMG from all units against the target by 20%. Each hit of Special Attack: Touch of Death inflicts a 10s Depleted Qi effect. This effect does not stack, but repeated hits on the same enemy will extend the duration.

skills.label: Mindscape 1: Qi Shield
skills.gameText: All units deal 10% increased DMG to enemies affected by Depleted Qi.

skills.label: Mindscape 2: Yunkui Pressure-Point Strike
skills.gameText: For every 6 points of Break Force consumed, Pan Yinhu will recover 4 Energy, and the Depleted Qi effect applied when Special Attack: Touch of Death hits an enemy will have its duration increased to 12s.

skills.label: Mindscape 3: Non-Meridian Pressure Point
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 4: First-Class Head Chef
skills.gameText: When Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor! heals all squad members, the HP recovery is increased by 25%, and the healing over time effect is increased by 25%. On activating Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor!, gain the Backup Provisions effect. Whenever any character in the squad loses HP, consume the Backup Provisions effect to instantly restore 50% of the HP recovered with Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor!'s instant HP recovery effect. This effect does not stack.

skills.label: Mindscape 5: "Thiren"
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 6: Meridian Theory
skills.gameText: The Meridian Flow effect provided by Core Passive: Meridian Enlightenment increases by an extra 6% of Pan Yinhu's initial ATK. The maximum Sheer Force provided by this effect increases to 720.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Swiftedge
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Launches up to four forward slashes, dealing Physical DMG.
Can be chained into Dash Attack: Phantasm Dash after the 4th hit.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Cloudstream Sword Will
skills.gameText:
Hold [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Launches a flurry of blade shockwaves, dealing Physical DMG. Hold to extend the attack.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased during this skill.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Splitting Currents
skills.gameText:
While in the Enlightened Mind state and on the ground, press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Performs up to three forward slashes, dealing Physical DMG.
If struck by an enemy attack during the 3rd hit, triggers a block, negating that instance of DMG.
If she possesses Qingming Sword Force, the 3rd hit is replaced with Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent
skills.gameText:
While in the Enlightened Mind state and with Qingming Sword Force, after the 2nd hit of Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Splitting Currents, press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Launches a swift rising attack, dealing Physical DMG and entering an airborne state.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum
skills.gameText:
After activating Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Annihilation, and with Qingming Sword Force, press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Launches a wide sweeping slash forward, dealing massive Physical DMG. On hit, 1 point of Qingming Sword Force is consumed.
If struck by an enemy during the skill, triggers a block, negating that instance of DMG and increasing the skill's Interrupt Level.
After using this skill and with Qingming Sword Force, press [EX Special Attack button] to consume 1 point of Qingming Sword Force and launch a hit of EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light. This skill is automatically followed up with Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent, and Ye Shunguang enters an airborne state.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight
skills.gameText:
In the Enlightened Mind state, and while airborne, press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Launches up to two downward slashes in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the Enlightened Mind state during this skill.
Press [EX Special Attack button] or [Dodge button] to follow up with Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Annihilation.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Annihilation
skills.gameText:
After the 2nd hit of Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight, press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Performs a falling attack in front, entering a grounded state, and dealing Physical DMG.
When launching this skill with 2 or more points of Qingming Sword Force, Ye Shunguang will perform a downward falling strike across a large area in front instead, dealing massive Physical DMG. On hit, 2 points of Qingming Sword Force are consumed, granting the Culmination effect. After using this skill, if Ye Shunguang possesses Qingming Sword Force, press [EX Special Attack button] to consume 1 point of Qingming Sword Force and launch a hit of EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light, which can be quickly followed up with Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the Enlightened Mind state during this skill.
During this skill, if attacked by enemies, triggers a block, negating that instance of DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Culmination
skills.gameText: During EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light, each time Qingming Sword Force is consumed while Culmination is active, the Qingming Sword Force cost is replaced by consuming Culmination instead. This effect does not stack, and lasts until the current Enlightened Mind ends.

skills.label: Dodge: Leave No Trace
skills.gameText:
Press [Dodge button] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
During the Enlightened Mind state, and if a Perfect Dodge is triggered, press [Basic Attack button] to activate Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent.

skills.label: Dodge: Wandering Cloud
skills.gameText:
While tilting the joystick, hold [Dodge button] to activate:
Enters a high-speed movement state. Steer with the joystick, and release the joystick to stop.

skills.label: Dash Attack: Phantasm Dash
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a dodge to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.label: Dodge Counter: Swallow Strike
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Leaps into the air and thrusts forward, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Special Attack: Guiding Tides
skills.gameText:
Press [Special Attack button] to activate:
If a dodge is available, 1 dodge chance is consumed, and the action is counted as activating a Dodge.
If no dodge is available or a Perfect Dodge is not triggered, launches a quick sword energy attack that deals Physical DMG.
If a Perfect Dodge is triggered at this time, launches a flying sword attack, dealing Physical DMG, and immediately follow up with the 2nd hit of Basic Attack: Swiftedge.
Character is briefly invulnerable during the skill.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Gale Suppression
skills.gameText:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack button] to activate:
Launches a rushing slash and a flying sword attack at the enemy, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Enemy attacks can be dodged during this skill.
After this skill is used, gain 1 point of Qingming Sword Force.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Clean Exit
skills.gameText:
While in the Enlightened Mind state and grounded, press [EX Special Attack button] to activate:
Performs a swift backstep slash, dealing Physical DMG.
If a dodge is available, 1 dodge chance is consumed, and the action is counted as activating a Dodge.
If a Perfect Dodge is triggered at this time, press [Basic Attack button] to quickly activate Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum and enter Vital View.
After this Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum activates, it can be immediately followed up with Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light
skills.gameText:
In the Enlightened Mind state and with Qingming Sword Force, hold [EX Special Attack button] to activate:
Performs quick consecutive slashes, dealing massive Physical DMG while rapidly consuming Qingming Sword Force until none remains.
The skill ends early if Qingming Sword Force is insufficient or if [EX Special Attack button] is released.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the Enlightened Mind state during this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Return to Dust
skills.gameText:
In the Enlightened Mind state, press [Ultimate button] or hold [EX Special Attack button] when all Qingming Sword Force is expended to activate:
Deals massive Physical DMG to enemies in a large area.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the Enlightened Mind state during this skill.
After using this skill, Ether Veil: Verdict is removed and the Enlightened Mind state ends.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Chain Attack: Smite the Wicked
skills.gameText:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful slash at enemies ahead in a large area, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Ultimate: Chasing Storms
skills.gameText:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate button] to activate:
Summons a sword formation and enter the Enlightened Mind state, activating an Ether Veil: Verdict while also gaining 6 Qingming Sword Force. This skill deals massive Physical DMG.
Upon activating this skill, if Decibels are consumed, press [Ultimate button] while in this Enlightened Mind state to launch an Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens that doesn't consume Decibels.
Enter the airborne state after using this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Chain Attack: Enlightened Mind - Lure Thunder
skills.gameText:
While in the Enlightened Mind state, and when a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful slash at enemies ahead in a large area, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the Enlightened Mind state during this skill.
Enter the airborne state after using this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens
skills.gameText:
After consuming Decibels to launch Ultimate: Chasing Storms and while in the Enlightened Mind state, press [Ultimate button] or hold [EX Special Attack button] when all Qingming Sword Force is expended to activate:
Summons a massive blade, dealing massive Physical DMG to enemies.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the Enlightened Mind state during this skill.
After using this skill, the Enlightened Mind state ends, and Ether Veil: Verdict is removed.
This skill doesn't consume Decibels.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Entry Skill: Illuminating Darkness
skills.gameText:
With 6 Qingming Sword Force and while not in the Enlightened Mind state, hold [Basic Attack button] to activate, or press [Switch button] while in combat and switch on-field from off-field to activate:
Enters the Enlightened Mind state and activates Ether Veil: Verdict.
Deals Physical DMG to enemies in a large area in front.
Activating this skill is considered as activating a Quick Assist.
Enters the airborne state after using this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Quick Assist: Support Guard
skills.gameText:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch button] to activate:
Leaps into the air and thrusts forward, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Assist Follow-Up: Cease Hostility
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Deals massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Defensive Assist: When I Return
skills.gameText:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch button] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Quick Assist: Enlightened Mind - Tactical Support
skills.gameText:
While in the Enlightened Mind state, when the active character is launched, press [Switch button] to activate:
Launches a forward slash, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Assist Follow-Up: Enlightened Mind - Unification
skills.gameText:
While in the Enlightened Mind state and after a Defensive Assist, press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Deals massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Core Passive: Burning Clarity (Core Skill level 7)
skills.gameText:
When not in the Enlightened Mind state and with fewer than 6 points of Qingming Sword Force, certain attacks slowly build Qingming Sword Force. Whenever Qingming Sword Force is gained by any means, each 1 point of Qingming Sword Force that exceeds the limit is converted into 1 stack of Bearer, stacking up to 3 times. Upon leaving the Enlightened Mind state, all Bearer stacks are consumed to grant the same number of Qingming Sword Force stacks.
Upon entering the battlefield, gain Unity, increasing CRIT Rate by 30% and DMG by 25%.
When Ultimate: Chasing Storms or Entry Skill: Illuminating Darkness is unleashed, Ye Shunguang enters the Enlightened Mind state and activates Ether Veil: Verdict. Ether Veil: Verdict has the same duration as Enlightened Mind. The duration lasts 16s, and the duration timer pauses while she is off-field. During the Enlightened Mind state, Ye Shunguang's skills are enhanced, all Physical DMG dealt by her skills becomes Honed Edge DMG.
While Ether Veil: Verdict is active, when an enemy enters Ether Veil: Verdict, they gain a Veil Vulnerability effect based on their current Stun DMG Multiplier. During this, when Ye Shunguang deals DMG to enemies with her skills, enemy Stun DMG Multiplier is ignored and replaced with the Veil Vulnerability bonus. Veil Vulnerability caps at 110%. The effect is removed when Ether Veil: Verdict ends.

skills.label: Additional Ability: Shadowtrace Flight
skills.gameText:
When another character in your squad is a Support or Defense character:
When a squadmate activates any Ether Veil, gain 3 points of Qingming Sword Force. If already in the Enlightened Mind state, this is instead converted into 3 stacks of Bearer.

skills.label: Mindscape 1: Dreambound Self
skills.gameText:
Upon entering the battlefield, gains 6 Qingming Sword Force. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode.
The Unity effect from Core Passive: Burning Clarity increases DMG dealt by an additional 10%, and they ignore 20% of the target's DEF.

skills.label: Mindscape 2: Light & Shadow
skills.gameText: The max stack count of Bearer increases to 6, and Culmination can stack up to 9 times. While in the Enlightened Mind state, each point of Qingming Sword Force consumed grants 1 stack of Culmination. EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light and Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens's DMG ignore 40% of the target's DEF.

skills.label: Mindscape 3: Swordswoman
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 4: Together into the Dust
skills.gameText: Upon entering the battlefield, gains 1,000 Decibels. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s. The Vulnerability bonus provided by Ether Veil: Verdict is increased to a maximum of 200%.

skills.label: Mindscape 5: Guiding Glimmer
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 6: Lantern Wish
skills.gameText: Upon entering the battlefield, gains 2 stacks of Lantern Wish. When entering the Enlightened Mind state, gains 1 stack of Lantern Wish, stacking up to 4 times. With 3 stacks of Lantern Wish, EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Return to Dust is replaced with Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens. When this Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens is activated, it consumes 3 stacks of Lantern Wish. The last hit of Enlightened Mind - Return to Dust and Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens deal 1,500% of ATK as additional Physical DMG.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Orbital Combo
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Perform up to five forward strikes, dealing Ether DMG.
The fifth attack is a Whim, conjuring an Ethereal figure that inflicts Ether DMG on enemies in a circular area ahead.
When in combat and not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 40 Dream Points upon using this Whim.

skills.label: Dodge: Fading Silhouette
skills.gameText:
Press [Dodge button] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Dash Attack: Refraction
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a dodge to activate:
Deliver a quick strike forward, dealing Ether DMG.

skills.label: Dodge Counter: Stardust Echo
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
This Dodge Counter is a Whim. When activated, summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a downward attack in a circular area ahead, dealing Ether DMG.
If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 20 Dream Points upon using this Whim. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Special Attack: Symphony of the Reaper - Storm
skills.gameText:
Press [Special Attack button] to activate:
This Special Attack is a Whim. When activated, it recreates an Ethereal figure that slashes forward in a line, dealing Ether DMG.
When in combat and not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 20 Dream Points upon using this Whim. This effect can trigger once every 5s.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Symphony of the Reaper - Daybreak
skills.gameText:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack button] to activate:
This EX Special Attack is a Harmony. When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a powerful forward slash in a line, dealing Ether DMG.
When Lucia uses any Harmony, all squad members gain the Darkbreaker state. While in Darkbreaker state, Sheer Force increases by 12. Every 200 points of Lucia's initial Max HP grants an additional (5 + 0.2 × Special Attack level) Sheer Force. The Darkbreaker state can increase Sheer Force by up to a maximum of (612 + 24 × Special Attack level), lasting 20s and repeated triggers reset the duration. When Lucia's initial Max HP reaches 24,000, the above bonus effect reaches its maximum value.
When any Harmony deals DMG, Lucia increases the final attack's DMG by an additional (34 + 3 × Special Attack level)% of her Max HP.
If she activates this EX Special Attack while in the Dream state and under the effect of Ether Veil: Wellspring, Ether Veil: Wellspring duration is extended by 16s.
After activating her EX Special Attack, Lucia can immediately follow up with the 5th hit of her Basic Attack.
If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 60 Dream Points upon using this Harmony.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Chain Attack: Stage of Brilliance
skills.gameText:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
This Chain Attack is a Harmony. When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that pulls in enemies in a circular area ahead and deals Ether DMG.
If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 40 Dream Points upon using this Harmony.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Ultimate: Charge, Great Armor!
skills.gameText:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate button] to activate:
This Ultimate is a Harmony. When activated, Lucia summons an Ethereal figure and rides it forward in a charge. Holding a directional button allows her to steer and extend the charge, up to 3s. During the charge, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, DMG taken is reduced by 40%, and when Lucia takes fatal DMG, she remains in battle with HP not dropping below 1.
When the charge ends, Lucia unleashes a powerful strike in a large area around her, dealing Ether DMG. A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy, and after the skill is used, it leaves behind a Starlight Convergence. Starlight Convergence lasts 8s. While inside Starlight Convergence, the currently active character gains HP regeneration equal to (1 + 0.05 × Chain Attack level)% of Lucia's Max HP per second. This effect ends 4s after leaving the Starlight Convergence or immediately when switching out.
After activation, if Lucia is in the Dream state and Ether Veil: Wellspring is active, Ether Veil: Wellspring duration is extended by 32s.
If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 100 Dream Points upon using this Harmony. If she is in the Dream state when activating this Harmony, she will gain 100 Dream Points and re-enter Dream state the next time she exits it. This effect cannot be stacked.
Character is invulnerable while performing the powerful strike.

skills.label: Quick Assist: Crushing Mist
skills.gameText:

skills.label: Mindscape 4: Flames of Justice
skills.gameText: While in combat, each use of Special Attack: Drive Suppression increases Starlight - Billy's CRIT DMG by 8%, stacking up to 2 times and lasting 45s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. If HP is below 35% and Starlight - Billy is not the active character, he continuously recovers HP, up to 35%.

skills.label: Mindscape 5: Radiant Armaments
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 6: Starlight Knight
skills.gameText: Ultimate: Starlight Knight Flying Kick and Basic Attack: Full-Throttle Starlight's Sheer DMG increases by 18%. Landing the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Knight's Technique, EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie, or Chain Attack: Knight's Swagger grants 1 stack of Brilliant Starlight, stacking up to 6 times, and gaining at most 1 stack per skill use. When using Ultimate: Starlight Knight Flying Kick or Basic Attack: Full-Throttle Starlight, consumes up to 2 stacks of Brilliant Starlight, with each stack consumed causing that skill's final hit to deal 100% Sheer Force as additional Physical DMG.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Do Stay a While
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Performs up to 4 strikes forward, dealing Wind DMG.

skills.label: Dodge: Excuse Me
skills.gameText:
Press [Dodge button] to activate:
Performs a quick dodge to the side.

skills.label: Dash Attack: Forgive My Rudeness
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a dodge to activate:
Strikes forward, dealing Wind DMG.

skills.label: Dodge Counter: Returned Courtesy
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing Wind DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Special Attack: Much Obliged
skills.gameText:
Press [Special Attack button] to activate:
Performs a forward strike, dealing Wind DMG.

skills.label: Special Attack: Forgive Me for Not Seeing You Off
skills.gameText:
After activating EX Special Attack: Kindly Rest in Peace, this attack is automatically activated when the total number of Eyes of the Storm on the field and Roxy's Wind Energy reaches at least 3:
Throws her hammer at enemies on the field, dealing Wind DMG.
Eyes of the Storm hit by this attack are detonated, up to 3 Eyes of the Storm at a time. Based on the number detonated, a corresponding number of Miniature Windstorms are generated, dealing Wind DMG.
If 3 Eyes of the Storm are detonated at once, a Giant Windstorm is generated instead, dealing Wind DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Don't Catch a Chill
skills.gameText:
With enough energy, press or hold [EX Special Attack button] to activate:
Slides forward, dealing Wind DMG.
While sliding, press and hold [EX Special Attack button] to have Roxy enter the Whirlwind state:
While in the Whirlwind state, Roxy generates a tornado. Drag the joystick to control its direction. During this, Energy is continuously consumed, dealing Wind DMG to enemies along its path. When Energy is depleted, or when [EX Special Attack button] is released while the joystick is not being moved, Roxy exits the Whirlwind state.
When the slide ends or when exiting the Whirlwind state, automatically follows up with EX Special Attack: Kindly Rest in Peace.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Kindly Rest in Peace
skills.gameText:
Automatically activates after EX Special Attack: Don't Catch a Chill ends:
Consumes all Wind Energy to fire a wind cannon forward, dealing Wind DMG.
After the attack, for each point of Wind Energy consumed, deals an additional instance of Wind DMG and generates 1 Eye of the Storm at the current position.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Eye of the Storm
skills.gameText:
Generated after EX Special Attack: Kindly Rest in Peace consumes Wind Energy, and automatically detonates after 30s.
Up to 9 Eyes of the Storm can exist at the same time. If this limit is exceeded, the earliest generated Eye of the Storm will automatically detonate.
Detonates when hit by Special Attack: Forgive Me for Not Seeing You Off. If fewer than 3 are hit at the same time, 1 Miniature Windstorm is generated at the location of each Eye of the Storm, tracking enemies and dealing Wind DMG for 1s.
If 3 are hit at the same time, 1 Giant Windstorm is generated instead, dealing Wind DMG for 1s.
When detonated by any means, an Eye of the Storm releases a blast, dealing 1 instance of Wind DMG to nearby enemies.

skills.label: Chain Attack: Gale-Burial Great Hammer
skills.gameText:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful strike at enemies in front, dealing massive Wind DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Ultimate: Requiem for the Night-Burial
skills.gameText:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate button] to activate:
Unleashes a powerful strike at enemies in front in a large area, dealing massive Wind DMG.
After the skill ends, gains 1 Wind Energy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Assist: More Overtime?
skills.gameText:
After activating a Defensive Assist, press [Switch button] again to activate:
Roxy stays on the field and strikes enemies ahead, dealing Wind DMG.
This skill is treated as activating a Basic Attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Quick Assist: At Your Service
skills.gameText:
When the on-field character is launched, press [Switch button] to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing Wind DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Defensive Assist: Allow Me to Assist
skills.gameText:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch button] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Assist Follow-Up: Midnight Code
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Strikes enemies ahead, dealing Wind DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Core Passive: Warm Night's Embrace (Core Skill level 7)
skills.gameText:
Gain 1 point of Wind Energy for every 25 Energy consumed, up to a maximum of 3 Wind Energy.
When Roxy's initial Energy Regen exceeds 1.2, for every 0.01 above this value, ATK increases by 5, up to a maximum increase of 960, and Impact increases by 0.4, up to a maximum increase of 76.8.
After Special Attack: Forgive Me for Not Seeing You Off hits an enemy affected by Windswept, it triggers Cleanse, reverting Contamination back to its original state.
When any squad member triggers Contamination or Cleanse, Roxy provides all squad members with a buff based on the attribute of the Contamination or Cleanse effect: for every 1% CRIT Rate Roxy has, when non-Armorer characters deal DMG of the corresponding attribute or Wind DMG, their CRIT DMG increases by 0.4%, up to 40%. When Armorer characters deal DMG of the corresponding attribute or Wind DMG, their Laceration DMG increases by 0.2%, up to 20%. Each attribute's buff lasts 50s, and repeated triggers reset the duration.
When Windswept is applied again to an enemy already in the Windswept state, all squad members can also gain this buff based on the Contamination attribute of the overwritten Windswept state and Wind attribute.

skills.label: Additional Ability: Porcelloy Heart
skills.gameText:
When another character in your squad is an Attack, Rupture, or Armorer character:
Roxy's DMG increases by 8%. This effect increases with character level, increasing by 1.2% per level, up to 80%.
When any squad member's attack hits an enemy, it increases their Stun DMG Multiplier by 30%. When an enemy becomes Stunned, its Stun duration is extended by 2s. This Stun duration increase does not stack with similar effects. The effect is removed once the Stun ends.
While an enemy is in the Windswept state applied by a squad member, the direct Wind DMG they take and the direct DMG they take of the attribute that triggered Contamination are increased by 8%.
Upon entering the battlefield, restores 40 Energy. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
Windswept applied by all squad members lasts 20s longer.
When using an EX Special Attack, Roxy's Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by 30% for 50s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

skills.label: Mindscape 1: Versatile Attendant
skills.gameText: When EX Special Attack: Kindly Rest in Peace hits, it reduces the enemy's All-Attribute RES by 15% for 50s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. CRIT DMG increases by 40%.

skills.label: Mindscape 2: Clocking Out Myth
skills.gameText:
EX Special Attack: Don't Catch a Chill deals 5% more Daze.
For each Eye of the Storm detonated, gain 1 stack of Windflow, up to 3 stacks.
During EX Special Attack: Don't Catch a Chill, if Roxy switches out after entering the Whirlwind state, she consumes all Windflow. Each stack consumed sustains the Whirlwind state for 0.2s, during which no Energy is consumed, up to a maximum of 0.6s.
When EX Special Attack: Don't Catch a Chill hits an enemy, that enemy's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 30% until the target recovers from Stun.

skills.label: Mindscape 3: Tales of Insomnia
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 4: R.I.P.
skills.gameText: When a Defensive Assist successfully parries an enemy attack, Roxy gains 1 Energy, up to once per skill. When Dodge Counter: Returned Courtesy hits an enemy, it grants 2 Energy, up to once per skill. Ultimate: Requiem for the Night-Burial deals 20% more DMG and 10% more Daze.

skills.label: Mindscape 5: Second Heartbeat
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 6: Eternity and the Clockwork Doll
skills.gameText:
The DMG dealt by attacks ignores 15% of the target's Wind RES.
When Special Attack: Forgive Me for Not Seeing You Off detonates Eyes of the Storm to generate a Giant Windstorm, the primary target is inflicted with Afterecho. A Giant Windstorm is generated at the target's location every 3s, for a total of 2 additional Giant Windstorms. Repeated triggers stack the number of additional Giant Windstorm instances generated and refresh the duration of Afterecho. The DMG dealt by the Giant Windstorm increases to 250% of its original value, and the Daze it inflicts increases by 20%.
